procs.name: Legionfall
procs.tooltip: Melee ability damage now has a $h% chance to reset the cooldown of |cffffffffAnnihilan Strike|r and cause your next |cFFFFFFFFAnnihilan Strike|r within $801902d to cost $801902s1% reduced Energy.
procs.trigger_spells_source: Annihilan Strike 801903 (cost 40 Energy, PowerType 3; CategoryRecoveryTime 10000; AttributesEx3 needs both weapons, so the Slayer pair) has two SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE effects (Effect[0] 801913 main hand, Effect[1] 801914 off hand) and no damage of its own; the two strikes are the landed hits. A trial is one landed hit of 801913 or 801914 on the dummy. Reference search: coa-history spell 801899 and 801902: 0 events in 186 logs; ~/CoaServer/reference snapshots (ascension-data advancement.tsv, bindmysoul talents) list the talent Legionfall 801899 without a rate or duration; nothing found for the value.
procs.trigger_lands_no_hit: AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:84: case 801899: return info && melee && !periodic && Chance(player, id): the handler rolls once per landed melee damage event of a spell, never per cast of 801903 or per aura application
procs.proc_spell_source: EffectTriggerSpell[0] of 801899; the handler casts it on the caster (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:201-203)
procs.handler: aura_ascension_felsworn_event (spell_script_names row of 801899, rev_20260909_05_felsworn_completion.sql:197-198): Check case 801899 (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:84) passes a melee spell damage event, rolling Chance(player, 801899); spell_proc Chance 100 (rev_20260928_95_felsworn_legionfall_proc_chance.sql) so the script's roll is the only probability; Proc (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:201-203) resets Annihilan Strike and casts 801902 on the caster.

behaviours.name: Legionfall
behaviours.quote: chance to reset the cooldown of Annihilan Strike and cause your next Annihilan Strike within $801902d to cost $801902s1% reduced Energy
behaviours.reason: Annihilan Strike 801903 costs 40 Energy with a 10000 ms category cooldown (Spell.dbc). 801902 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELLMOD_COST, EffectBasePoints -51 (-50%), is the marker; Effect[1] 195 resets the cooldown of 801903. A proc is read as a rise of the 801902 cast count; the cooldown must read 0 after a fired cast, the next cast must cost the reduced amount (20 Energy) and every other cast the full cost (40); the 20 casts without the passive are the control arm. Script path AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:84, :201-203.

behaviours.name: Unholy Endurance (Carve damage)
behaviours.quote: Increases the damage and threat generated from Carve by $s1%.
behaviours.observe_source: Hit size: both arms carry attack power +20000 (fixture, a named precondition, the same in control and treatment). Carve's strike is 20% weapon damage (AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:166-175) and the weapon roll includes the normalized attack power term, so a hit is about 890 points in the control arm and 1023 with the passive (measured hit sizes of the counted pair): each of the two integer truncations of SpellEffects.cpp:4743 and Unit.cpp:11670 loses under 1 point, so under 0.12% of a hit each and under 0.25% together, inside the band of 2 points; at ~30-point hits the same truncations cost about 3 points of the 15 (the first proves read +11.1% and +12.3% from that truncation, not from the server). $s1 = 15 (300466 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectBasePoints 14 + EffectDieSides 1, MiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE; Spell.dbc read with apps/coa-dbc/inspect_dbc.py), class mask 0x80 of family 20 widened by AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:29-33 to 0x80/0/0x200000. Carve's strike 803715 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 0x80, weapon percent damage) is cast at the dummy trials times without the passive (control) and with it learned by a real learn (treatment), non-critical hits only; mean damage per hit must rise by 15 percent (band 13..17, G-19). The control arm is the same cast without 300466. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 300466: 0 events in 186 logs (passive, never logged); coa-history spell 803715 (Carve hit): SPELL_DAMAGE 1086 events in 5 logs, 188 crits, min 37 max 1630 mean 307 (gear and channel length differ, no figure decides); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22): Unholy Endurance 300466, Tyrant specialization, 'Increases the damage and threat generated from Carve by 15%.', same figure as the tooltip; nothing else found.

behaviours.observe_source: Control of the threat entry: Carve's strike 803715 without 300466 must give threat = damage plus the initial threat of its SpellLevel 11 (Spell.dbc SpellLevel 11, no SPELL_EFFECT_THREAT, Spell.cpp:5731-5737 adds SpellLevel when the spell has no spell_threat row and no SPELL_ATTR0_CU_NO_INITIAL_THREAT), so (threat - 11) / damage = 1. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 300466: 0 events in 186 logs (passive, never logged); coa-history spell 803715 (Carve hit): SPELL_DAMAGE 1086 events in 5 logs, 188 crits, min 37 max 1630 mean 307 (gear and channel length differ, no figure decides); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22): Unholy Endurance 300466, Tyrant specialization, 'Increases the damage and threat generated from Carve by 15%.', same figure as the tooltip; nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Unholy Endurance (Carve threat)
behaviours.quote: Increases the damage and threat generated from Carve by $s1%.
behaviours.observe_source: $s2 = 15 (300466 Effect[1] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectBasePoints 14 + 1, MiscValue 2 = SPELLMOD_THREAT), mask widened as for Effect[0]. ThreatManager::CalculateModifiedThreat (ThreatManager.cpp:703-714) applies ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_THREAT) to the damage threat; the flat initial threat of SpellLevel 11 is added with ignoreModifiers (Spell.cpp:5757-5762) and stays 11, so with 300466 learned (a real learn after the hit spell) (threat - 11) / damage = 1.15. The control arm is the control entry (slope 1 without the passive). behaviours.name: Nether Spirit (spell critical strike rating)
behaviours.quote: Increases your spell critical strike rating by $s1% of your Spirit.
behaviours.observe_source: 300477 Effect[0] aura 220 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT, EffectMiscValue 1024 (CR_CRIT_SPELL 10), EffectMiscValueB 4 (Spirit), $s1 = 20 (EffectBasePoints 19 + 1). Greatness 60235 (Effect[0] aura 29 SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT, MiscValue 4, EffectBasePoints 299 + 1 = +300 Spirit, SPELL_ATTR2_ALLOW_LOW_LEVEL_BUFF so it is not level-scaled) is a real cast on the caster in both phases: Spirit = class file reference stat 4 (50) + 300 x 1.03 = 359, the +3% being the Human racial The Human Spirit 20598 (Effect[0] aura 137 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE, MiscValue 4, EffectBasePoints 2 + 1; the class file race is 1, Human); 20% of 359 = 71.8, truncated to 71 as PlayerUpdates.cpp:662-670 does (int32(CalculatePct(stat, pct))). A first run read Spirit 359 and rating 71 against an expected 350 and 70 written without the racial: the expectation was corrected from the DBC racial, not from the reading. Combat rating 10 is read before (300477 not learned, control: 0) and after a real learn; the spirit_read entry reads the Spirit itself. First attempt with Divine Spirit 48073 (BasePoints 79, BaseLevel 80) read Spirit 101 (+51, not +80) and rating 20 = 20% of 101: a fixture scaling, not a defect of 300477. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 300477: 0 events in 186 logs (passive); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) words the passive 'spell critical strike chance by 20% of your Spirit' (Infernal specialization), an older and different text; the tooltip and the DBC effect (rating from stat) govern; nothing else found.

behaviours.observe_source: $/1000;S1 = 5 sec: 807430 Effect[0] aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), EffectBasePoints 4999 + 1 = 5000 ms, class mask word 2 0x40 matching Skull of Gul'dan 800225 (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 0x40, DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms, SpellDuration.dbc). Skull is cast on the caster before (control: 807430 not learned, 10000 ms less the 100 ms wait) and after a real learn (15000 less 100); the tolerance 300 excludes a gain 10% off (4500 or 5500). Effect[2] of 807430 is SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY, not an aura, so its pct modifier is inert (observation, not changed). Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 807430: 0 events in 186 logs (passive); spell 800225: SPELL_AURA_APPLIED 16 events in 4 logs (no duration figure for the passive); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) 'Increases the duration of Skull of Gul'dan by 5 sec.'; nothing else found.
